name: host-forwarded-rule-split
title: Split host and forwarded rule domains in the configuration
description: Separate the single rules list into explicit host-originated and forwarded (other-NIC) rule domains, with the capture-scope and fallback contracts that follow.
creator: qmazon

meta.test_baseline_2026_10_04: 1161 tests across 13 assemblies (Configuration 101, Capture 115, Core 61, Flow 151, Integration 22, NdisApi 74, Performance 129, Protocols 71, Socks5 52, TcpRedirect 155, UdpProxy 154, Windows 58, Analyzers 18); all green on the first full run.
meta.configmodels_effective_lines: 375 against the 400 limit (directory-structure.md:81); the split must extract ConfigurationRules to stay compliant.
meta.known_host_flakes: Pre-existing ~13.8% full-suite false-failure rate from host lumps, documented in hot-path.md:1125-1134: CapturePumpReadCallTests.CountingReaderIdleIterationsAllocateNoManagedBytes, SweepAllocationGateTests.FlowTableSweepAllocatesNoManagedBytes 7384B, LayeredCaptureRunnerHealthSignalTests.FailureThresholdForcesARefreshDespiteIdenticalEnumeration. One such failure was observed on the second baseline run and three isolated reruns were green.
meta.outcome: Implemented. Configuration now exposes required 'host' and optional 'forwarded' domains, each with its own optional rules list and fallbackAction; rule eligibility is positional. PolicySnapshot holds HostRules/ForwardedRules with EvaluateHost/EvaluateForwarded and per-domain fallbacks; RuleMatcher.IsAdapterQualified deleted. CaptureAdapterScopeResolver walks both lists with domain-qualified diagnostics. Process selectors are rejected inside forwarded.rules. New file ConfigurationRules.cs holds the extracted rule-domain parser (ConfigurationModels.cs 375 -> 230 effective lines). The old top-level 'rules' key is deliberately not special-cased.
meta.gates_final: dotnet format --verify-no-changes: exit 0, empty output. dotnet build -c Release: 0 warnings. dotnet test -c Release: 1174 passed / 0 failed across 13 assemblies (baseline 1161 + 13). jb inspectcode -e=HINT: 0 <Issue> entries.
meta.defects_found: Two pre-existing defects surfaced and were fixed: (1) ConfigurationLimitsTests.ExampleConfigurationsAllValidate resolved examples/ with six '..' segments, landing outside the repo, so Directory.Exists was false and the test silently validated nothing; it now walks up to the directory containing WinForward.slnx and was negative-tested with an injected unknown field. (2) TcpFragmentHandlingTests.FragmentHarness.CreateForwarded relied on the implicit adapter-qualified-is-forwarded model; its rule moved into the forwarded domain.
meta.tests_added: 12 new regressions: Core +2 (unqualified forwarded rules match; each domain reads only its own list), Core +1 net from replacing the old contract test (ForwardedFallbackDefaultsToPassAndIsConfigurable, ForwardedPolicyPreservesRuleOrderAndMatcherConditions); Configuration +6 (omitted forwarded domain defaults to pass, unqualified forwarded rule accepted, configured forwarded fallback read, proxy fallback rejected in the forwarded domain, process selectors rejected in the forwarded domain, domain-qualified rule diagnostics); Capture +3 (forwarded adapter constraint drives scope, unconstrained forwarded rule widens scope, scope diagnostics name the domain); Flow +1 (forwarded match logs rule=0 with origin=Forwarded).
meta.trellis_check: Dispatched read-only after the gates went green. Verified all 9 acceptance criteria with file:line evidence and independent dotnet fsi probes against the Release assemblies; token-diffed the extracted parser bodies against HEAD (behavior-preserving: ParseAction/ValidateNonEmpty/NormalizeSet/ParseNetworks/ParseSet/ParsePorts byte-identical, ParseRule differs only by the path parameter and the new forwarded-process rejection, and it still seeds FlowDecision.RuleIndex from the per-domain index). Cleared: no residual implicit-model assumptions anywhere in src/tests/benchmarks/specs/README/examples; nested unknown keys are still rejected at every level.
meta.check_findings_fixed: 1 (must fix) AdapterScopeWidensForAnUnconstrainedForwardedRule was tautological: with host.rules empty, the resolver's own empty-scope widening produced the asserted count, so a regression that stopped walking ForwardedRules would still pass. Fixture now pins the scope with an adapter-constrained host rule. 2 ExampleConfigurationsAllValidate's 'exampleDir is null -> return' was the last silent-pass path; it is now fatal. 3 Added the missing refresh-mode forwarded coverage (RefreshNarrowsAForwardedRulesDisappearedSelectorWithADomainQualifiedWarning). 4 directory-structure.md's 'kept cohesive under the limit' precedent no longer names ConfigurationModels.cs.
meta.discriminating_test_proof: Temporarily fed an empty list to the forwarded AccumulateScope calls: AdapterScopeFollowsAForwardedDomainsAdapterConstraint, AdapterScopeWidensForAnUnconstrainedForwardedRule, AdapterScopeDiagnosticsNameTheRuleDomain and RefreshNarrowsAForwardedRulesDisappearedSelectorWithADomainQualifiedWarning all failed (4/119 red). The walk was then restored and the suite returned to 119/119, so all four pin the forwarded list.
